state.key: selectedDriverId (tagged with raceId; null on race switch)
state.scope: workspace-canonical; every module consumes, none owns a second copy
state.precedent: ReplayView already tags selection with raceId (selection.raceId === replay.raceId ? driverId : null); extend this pattern workspace-wide

immediate: one primary model value + one simulation value (compact)
on_DETAILS: ranks + leader disagreement + MC precision (k/n/SE/Wilson) + Wilson interval

rules: never show all fields simultaneously unless justified; default is immediate set only
cross-frame selection yields null explanation (existing PredictionPanel gating kept)
non-observable driver names stay inert (existing rule kept)
selection change issues no independent fetches; intelligence reads workspace T state
